name: frontend-ai-workflow
description: Reusable frontend delivery and project-local UI review with structured interactions, deterministic comparison, cross-platform bundled Chromium, optional visual fallback, safe repair, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap and govern reusable AI workflows for frontend repositories.
interface.longDescription: Inspect Vue and React repositories, create durable project guidance and governed requirements, drive an OpenSpec 1.7 change lifecycle, and run portable UI review with structured interactions, deterministic DOM or image comparison, bundled macOS ARM and Linux x64 Chromium, optional visual fallback, explicitly gated source repair, and same-context verification without a separate management platform.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this frontend repository with the shared AI workflow.
Turn my feature description into a reviewable requirement document.
Review a configured frontend page through the unified deterministic runner, use visual fallback only for declared inconclusive results, safely fix approved UI findings, and verify the result.
